claim: The Google Earth Engine COPERNICUS/S1_GRD collection is already calibrated, terrain-corrected and log-scaled to decibels, so applying 10*log10 to its VV/VH values again is scientifically incorrect.
conditions: This statement applies to COPERNICUS/S1_GRD; COPERNICUS/S1_GRD_FLOAT has different value semantics.
limitations: Additional speckle filtering or terrain-normalization decisions may still be needed and must be documented separately.
recommended_action: Use VV and VH directly as dB values and record additional_log_transform=false in feature provenance.
not_allowed_action: Do not apply a second logarithmic conversion to COPERNICUS/S1_GRD.
